cohort: The study included 539,390 live-born, singleton children born in Norway between 2008 and 2018.
finding: Both prenatal antibiotic exposure (aHR, 1.22) and cesarean section (aHR, 1.14) were independently associated with an increased risk of otolaryngology surgery in offspring, with some evidence of interaction between the two exposures.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with an increased risk of otolaryngology surgery in offspring (aHR, 1.14; 95% CI: 1.11-1.16).
